svg.title: Illustrative cumulative undiscounted cash flow relative to all API for three monthly token scenarios: 24 billion input plus 6 billion output, 64 billion input plus 16 billion output, and the 24B-input/6B-output workload with API prices falling 30 percent annually. Each starts at minus 1.6 million RMB. The 64B-input/16B-output scenario first repays the investment at month 32. Operating savings exclude resale value. These are assumptions, not measured hardware performance.
